faqs.question: How long does a typical Website Development engagement take?
faqs.answer: Most marketing sites launch in 4–8 weeks. Larger content systems or multi-locale sites often take 8–12+ weeks.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate with your CRM, analytics, CMS preferences, and brand guidelines, and we collaborate with internal stakeholders.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: Core Web Vitals, conversion rate, lead quality, SEO readiness, and how easily your team can update content.

faqs.question: Which stack do you recommend?
faqs.answer: We choose based on goals — often Next.js for performance/SEO, WordPress for editorial speed, or Shopify when commerce is core.

faqs.question: Do you handle UX and development together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Design and engineering stay connected so the site ships beautiful and buildable — no throw-over-the-wall comps.

faqs.question: Will the site be accessible?
faqs.answer: We aim for WCAG-minded structure: semantics, contrast, keyboard use, and forms that work with assistive tech.

faqs.question: SEO foundations included?
faqs.answer: Yes — metadata, sitemap/robots, schema basics, performance, and clean URL architecture from day one.

faqs.question: Can you redesign an existing site?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We modernize UX and tech while protecting SEO equity with redirects and content mapping.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Book a discovery call via WhatsApp or the contact form. You get a scoped proposal with timeline and investment.

faqs.question: Who is on the project team?
faqs.answer: A delivery lead, designer, and engineers — plus SEO/marketing specialists when growth outcomes are in scope.
